text: You are getting your vaccinations today. You don't like the idea of getting a shot.

choices.label: Cry the whole time
choices.resultText: You cried the whole time, but the nurse said you did great anyway.

choices.label: Stay brave
choices.resultText: You surprised everyone by staying brave through the shot.

choices.label: Try to squirm away
choices.resultText: You squirmed and wriggled, but there was no escaping it.

text: You're learning to walk and keep wobbling around the living room.

choices.label: Keep trying
choices.resultText: You kept falling and getting back up until you finally took your first real steps.

choices.label: Hold onto the furniture
choices.resultText: You stuck close to the couch, cruising along the edge of it instead.

text: Everyone's been waiting for it, and you finally say your first word.

choices.label: Say "Mama" or "Dada"
choices.resultText: You said your first word and your family couldn't stop celebrating.

choices.label: Just babble instead
choices.resultText: You babbled happily, not quite ready for real words yet.

text: Your teeth are coming in and your gums are sore.

choices.label: Fuss and cry about it
choices.resultText: You fussed and cried for days until the new tooth finally came through.

choices.label: Chew on anything nearby
choices.resultText: You gnawed on everything within reach to soothe your gums.

text: You've been waking up crying in the middle of the night, over and over.

choices.label: Keep everyone up
choices.resultText: You kept the whole house up most nights this year.

choices.label: Settle down after some comforting
choices.resultText: A little comforting each night was usually enough to settle you back down.

text: A friendly stranger at the playground leans down and says hello to you.

choices.label: Hide behind your parent's leg
choices.resultText: You hid behind your parent's leg until the stranger walked away.

choices.label: Wave back and smile
choices.resultText: You waved and smiled, delighted by the attention.

text: You've become completely attached to one toy and refuse to go anywhere without it.

choices.label: Carry it everywhere
choices.resultText: You carried it everywhere and had a meltdown the one time it got left behind.

choices.label: Share it with a cousin
choices.resultText: You reluctantly let a cousin play with it for a little while.

text: A loud thunderstorm rattles the windows one night and you're terrified.

choices.label: Run to your parents' bed
choices.resultText: You ran straight to your parents' bed and slept there the rest of the night.

choices.label: Try to tough it out alone
choices.resultText: You tried to tough it out alone, hiding under the blankets until it passed.

text: You've suddenly decided you only want to eat about three different foods.

choices.label: Refuse everything else
choices.resultText: You refused pretty much everything that wasn't one of your three foods.

choices.label: Try a few new bites
choices.resultText: You grudgingly tried a few new bites, to your parents' relief.

text: It's time for your very first haircut, and the clippers make you nervous.

choices.label: Sit still for it
choices.resultText: You sat still the whole time and everyone said how grown-up you looked afterward.

choices.label: Squirm through the whole thing
choices.resultText: You squirmed through the whole thing and ended up with a slightly crooked fringe.

text: Today's your first day at daycare, and you're not sure what to make of all these new kids.

choices.label: Make an effort to play with others
choices.resultText: You warmed up and started playing with the other kids by the end of the day.

choices.label: Stick close to the teacher instead
choices.resultText: You stuck close to the teacher for most of the day, watching everyone else from a safe distance.

text: A kid at daycare keeps sitting next to you at snack time and wants to play together.

choices.label: Become friends
choices.resultText: You and your new daycare friend became inseparable.

choices.label: Keep to yourself
choices.resultText: You were polite, but mostly kept to yourself.

text: You found a marker and decided the living room wall needed some artwork.

choices.label: Proudly show off your masterpiece
choices.resultText: You proudly showed off your wall masterpiece. Your parents were less impressed.

choices.label: Try to hide the evidence
choices.resultText: You tried to hide the evidence, but the marker gave you away almost instantly.

text: You stacked your blocks higher than ever before, and your family made a big deal out of it.

choices.label: Soak up the praise
choices.resultText: You soaked up the praise and immediately wanted to build it even higher.

choices.label: Knock it down and start over
choices.resultText: You knocked it down just to build it again, more interested in the process than the praise.
